description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care outcomes and foster a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a visionary leader who can uphold the highest standards of clinical excellence and operational efficiency.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and developing a team of compassionate healthcare professionals. This is an urgent opening, and we are looking to fill this critical position quickly with a candidate who is ready to make an immediate difference. Join a facility committed to providing exceptional care and a positive work culture.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven leadership experience in a long-term care or skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent clinical, communication, and organizational skills
Ability to manage and mentor a diverse nursing team

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Special Education Teacher for a contract position within a local school district in Walterboro, SC. This role offers a competitive hourly rate starting at $50/hr. The initial contract period is from August 19, 2026, to June 16, 2027. Join a supportive educational environment committed to fostering student growth and success.

This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on students' lives by developing and implementing individualized education programs (IEPs) and collaborating with colleagues and parents to support student achievement.
requirements: Valid South Carolina Special Education teaching certification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Special Education or a related field
Experience working with students with diverse learning needs
Ability to develop and implement individualized education programs (IEPs)
